title: Amiga Hardware Programming 1 - Use the Assembler and wait for left click
summary: The first video in Photon of Scoopex's Amiga hardware programming series. It shows how to set up an assembler and write a minimal 68000 program that waits for a left mouse click.
why: Recommended as an approachable start to Amiga demo and 68000 assembly programming.

quote.text: you should fasten your seatbelts and check out this video tutorials by Photon of Scoopex
